description: Hermes-compatible agent skills library. Each skill is a self-contained folder with SKILL.md + references/.

skills.name: agy
skills.description: Delegate a coding, refactor, PR-review, or image task to the Antigravity CLI (agy) as an autonomous worker. Use when delegating such a task to agy/Antigravity, or running the agy CLI.

skills.name: art
skills.description: Generates images, diagrams, and visual output. Use when producing any visual artifact.

skills.name: backend-design
skills.description: Use when reference for API design, database schema, and server architecture.

skills.name: build
skills.description: Implements plan tasks one at a time with compile and commit gates. Use when building from a plan.

skills.name: codebase-onboarding
skills.description: Analyze an unfamiliar codebase and produce an onboarding guide — architecture map, entry points, conventions, starter CLAUDE.md. Use when joining a new project or onboarding a repo.

skills.name: coding-standards
skills.description: Reference for house coding standards across TypeScript, Python, PowerShell, Bash, Swift, and Rust. Use when writing or reviewing code to match project conventions.

skills.name: context-budget
skills.description: Audit context-window consumption across agents, skills, MCP servers, and rules, and produce prioritized token-savings recommendations. Use when context feels bloated or you want to cut token usage.

skills.name: create-cli
skills.description: Generate a production-ready TypeScript CLI (3-tier: manual argv / Commander / oclif). Use when create CLI, build a command-line tool, wrap an API as a CLI, or add a command.

skills.name: create-mcp
skills.description: Build a Model Context Protocol (MCP) server with the official SDK — tools, resources, prompts, transport, and security. Use when creating, scaffolding, connecting, or debugging an MCP server.

skills.name: create-skill
skills.description: Use when creating, validating, testing, improving, or canonicalizing a Hermes skill. Routes to the correct workflow based on intent.

skills.name: data-report-builder
skills.description: Turn a raw Excel/CSV dataset into a two-layer report — plain-language summary plus untouched raw data. Use when someone shares a spreadsheet wanting a report, analysis, summary, or breakdown.

skills.name: docker-patterns
skills.description: Use when reference for Docker and Docker Compose local dev patterns.

skills.name: frontend-aesthetics
skills.description: Visual direction — typography, color, hierarchy, motion — so UI isn't generic AI-slop. Use when make it less generic, polish the UI, looks templated/AI-made, or design direction. NOT FOR component

skills.name: frontend-design
skills.description: Use when working with frontend-design. Reference for building React/Next.js components, hooks, state, and performance. NOT FOR visual styling, typography, color, or making UI look less generic (use FrontendAesthetics).

skills.name: git-hub-ops
skills.description: Manage a GitHub repo via the gh CLI — hygiene, changelog, commit/push, PRs, releases, branch cleanup. Use when running gh repo operations.

skills.name: git-workflow
skills.description: Reference for git branching strategies, commit conventions, merge vs rebase, and conflict resolution. Use when choosing a branching model, resolving conflicts, or setting commit conventions. NOT FOR running gh repo

skills.name: hygiene
skills.description: Use when audit ~/.claude for git, skill, code, and rules hygiene issues.

skills.name: iterate
skills.description: Refine a target across bounded passes toward a goal, with a state file and a hard exit condition. Use when iterate, refine, loop, keep improving, or run until done.

skills.name: iterative-depth
skills.description: Run 2-8 lens passes over the same problem to surface requirements and edge cases a single angle misses. Use when exploring deeper, multi-angle analysis, or surfacing hidden requirements before building.

skills.name: open-code
skills.description: Delegate a coding, refactor, or PR-review task to the OpenCode CLI as an autonomous worker. Use when delegating such a task to OpenCode, or running the opencode CLI.

skills.name: orchestrate
skills.description: Decompose a spec into a dependency DAG, build units in parallel via delegation, review each in a separate context. Use when orchestrating multi-unit or parallel work, or landing a large

skills.name: pi
skills.description: Delegate a coding, refactor, or PR-review task to the Pi (pi.dev) CLI as an autonomous worker. Use when delegating such a task to Pi, or running the pi CLI.

skills.name: prompting
skills.description: Vendor-agnostic prompt-engineering standard library. Use when authoring or refining a prompt, system message, skill, agent instruction, or rule file.

skills.name: reflect
skills.description: Self-rate the just-finished output on five axes with evidence, then fix any gap scored ≤3. Use when a non-trivial task finishes — 3+ files, a multi-step workflow, or 3+ debug

skills.name: research
skills.description: Research a question at three depths (quick / standard / deep multi-agent fan-out), then synthesize cited findings. Use when researching a topic, gathering sources, comparing options, or getting a cross-provider

skills.name: security-review
skills.description: Audits code for vulnerabilities and secrets. Use when reviewing code for security issues.

skills.name: simplify
skills.description: Post-implementation dead-code cleanup. Use when running /simplify after finishing a feature or fix.

skills.name: skill-forge
skills.description: Audit the whole skill library for agentic readiness and instrument it with telemetry in bulk. Use when auditing skills for autonomy, finding agentic gaps, or adding execution logging across skills.

skills.name: spec
skills.description: Explores code + LTM, then writes acceptance criteria. Use when defining what to build before planning.

skills.name: strategic-compact
skills.description: Use when reference for context compaction strategy and timing guidance.

skills.name: tdd-workflow
skills.description: Test-first development workflow. Use when writing a feature test-first or fixing a bug with TDD.

skills.name: test
skills.description: Runs TDD for features and bug fixes. Use when testing a new feature or fixing a bug with tests.

skills.name: verify
skills.description: Run a build/type/lint/test/secret/diff gate ending in a READY / NOT READY verdict. Use when verifying changes, before commit or PR, or as a quality gate.
